figures.caption: Figure 1: Pre-execution judgment fails late. Selective accuracy of the pre-run judgment on the 366-pair benchmark, by the number of successful changes already accumulated (nbaseline). We use confidence cliff for the regime where selective accuracy falls while coverage does not. Without memory, selective accuracy collapses 25.9 points once three or more successes have accumulated, while coverage (dotted, right axis) rises from 76% to 85%; the focused store holds selective accuracy at 83.5% and lowers coverage instead.

Table 3: Model endpoints used in the experiments and their closest public documentation. Endpoint IDs are CodeBuddy serving names or aliases rather than frozen checkpoints; the citation column does not assert checkpoint identity.

Figure 4: Late-stage returns diminish in the AutoSOTA logs. On the AutoSOTA optimization logs: (a) the share of agent-proposed modifications that improve the metric falls from 70% in iterations 1–2 to 43% by iteration 6+; (b) even among the modifications that do work, the mean improvement shrinks from 3.6% to 0.3%. This motivates measuring pre-execution judgment: late in a run, most experiments are executed and then reverted.

Table 2: Focused outcome memory keeps late judgment reliable. Cliff-bucket ablation (nbaseline ≥ 3). Coverage is the verdict rate under strict consensus; selective accuracy is accuracy conditioned on a verdict.

Figure 3: Pre-run selection improves live-loop search efficiency. Best-so-far improvement over baseline in live loops, mean over five seeds (± one std). (a) On nanochat, propose-many tracks vanilla, selection front-loads progress, and the focused store (Rehearse) achieves the highest endpoint. (b–c) On two additional loops (CIFAR-10, ETTh1), Rehearse reaches a better endpoint under the same 100-experiment training-run budget, with lower observed seed-to-seed spread on ETTh1.

Figure 2: Overview of Rehearse. Rehearse turns a one-idea-then-run cycle into Propose–Predict– Execute: propose multiple candidate modifications, rank them with focused outcome memory, run the top candidate, and write its result back to the store.
